source: Exact deterministic replay of the previously selected A3 event; use the existing disjoint long-continuation 32-note relative panel and A3 real/skip immediate probes as mandatory reference matches.
source_group_rule: All selected plastic edges are relay->motor. Each relay has a unique sensory parent; sensory index//4 identifies its preferred time-to-contact bin. Partition bins 0-3 (500/400/300/200 ms), 4-6 (150/100/75 ms), and 7-9 (50/25/0 ms). Apply the real raw proposal and ordinary bounds only on that group's edges.
clipping_group_rule: Before probing, classify each edge by whether the REAL full proposed weight exceeds a bound. Apply the real raw proposal and ordinary bounds only on the selected clipped or unclipped edges. These two disjoint applied vectors sum exactly to the actual full applied vector.
eligibility_age_rule: Use exact replay snapshots at t-450 ms and t-150 ms, with tau_eligibility=150 ms. At t, e_older150=e(t-150)*exp(-150/tau) and e_recent150=e(t)-e_older150. Also report e_older450=e(t-450)*exp(-450/tau) and the 150-450 ms remainder. These are ages of eligibility additions, not reconstructed pre/post spike lags. Apply eta*D times one component with ordinary clipping on the unchanged pre-update weights; the two independently clipped age interventions need not sum to the full applied update.
sign_reversal_rule: Apply the exact negative of the recorded dopamine/RPE amplitude with the full existing eligibility through the unchanged production plasticity method; no new scale parameter.
probe: From the identical true pre-dopamine state, advance the plasticity clock in every branch. Change only the selected effective weights, then freeze plasticity and exploration on the same 32-note relative panel. Preserve neuron/queue/readout/predictor/RNG/topology state. Record all per-note signed attempts and every DOWN time, motor spike totals and readout decisions where available.
primary_timing_effect: Mean paired signed scored-attempt error in ms against no_update, using only note indices with errors in both branches. Negative means earlier. Also report each branch's mean signed attempt error, hit-only MAE if defined, utility and GOOD+.
interpretation_rule: A component reproduces most of the full timing advance only if its paired shift is in the same direction and at least 50% of the full paired shift. An opposing component must delay paired presses by at least 10 ms. Magnitude alone never establishes behavioral causality. Report interactions/nonadditivity and clipping separately. No group, cutoff, step, or branch may be changed after probe results.
scope: Synthetic diagnostic only. Do not alter the production learning rule, tune eta, run more training or infer fly physiology from this fixture.
